evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native clinical note forms can reduce repeated headings and field handling while device programming remains clinician controlled.

assumptions: Unmeasured actual implant fitting episode; shares are independent of the prompt prior. No device settings, fitting parameters or clinical advice are generated by this proposal.

Existing clinical work produces actual history and test records. s1 counts review; s2 actual program determination and complete final-program checking; s4 actual monitoring. Additional fitting repeats s2 and s3 with a newly checked exact version before each device write, not a hidden automatic adjustment.

s5 counts actual clinical note capture and complete final checking. Native form structure saves only repeated headings and fields, not patient findings or existing automatic device logs. No device-result import or clean clinical feed is assumed free.

Both device application and note commit are separate gated actions, fully retained with no saving. Identity or program changes invalidate the device gate; note changes invalidate its gate. Existing equivalent forms earn no additional benefit.
Gross 1.3 minus 0.5 upkeep gives 0.8 net per 100 baseline focal hours.

Existing clinical work produces actual assessment records; s1 counts retrieval and verification. s2 counts necessary consultation, s3 actual plan authorship and capture, and s4 actual treatment and response observation. No free complete plan or clean clinical feed is assumed.
